Author: SpecialAgentSkye
Name: SkyeMeter 2.0
Description: SkyeMeter connects to IINACT to display real-time DPS, HPS, and encounter statistics with a customizable ImGui interface. Features include pet damage merging, dual DPS/HPS tables, history tracking, and extensive visual customization. Additionally, we calculate the actual healing done, instead of merging healing and overhealing, for a REAL display of the healing done by each Combatant.
Punchline: A modern DPS meter overlay for FFXIV
Changelog:
Native render mode meaning in game window instead of overlays (beta)

New beta render mode that draws the meters with the game's own UI system instead of ImGui.
Switch it in Settings → Display.
Works combined (all tables in one window) or with Healing and Damage Taken detached.
Drag, resize, and lock the native windows; position and size can also be typed into settings. Notice that the position and scale data is seperate from the non native meters.
If anything goes wrong natively, it falls back to the normal renderer automatically.
Fixed an issue that swallowed all escape presses if no more closeable windows were present

Columns are now built from text templates, so you can change what each one shows.
28 values available (dps, rdps, crit%, healed, deaths, and more) plus short aliases.
Number formatting options per value: thousands, raw, percent, decimals.
Column headers and widths are editable.
Existing setups are migrated and look exactly the same until you change something.

Reads live status effects from memory, so DoT and HoT ticks are matched far more reliably.
Fills in status timelines when log lines go missing.
DoT and skill data fixes

DoT damage waits for ACT totals to catch up during heavy bursts before giving up.
The Spear (Astrologian) now contributes to rDPS — it was doing nothing at all.
Fixed wrong ability IDs for Devilment, Dokumori and Arcane Circle.
Embolden's self-buff corrected to 10%.
Combust was labelled as a White Mage spell; it's Astrologian /facepalm.
Added low-level DoTs for synced content: Aero, Aero II, Thunder I–IV, Bio, Bio II, Chaos Thrust.
Added missing HoTs: Physis, Angel's Whisper, Helios Conjunction, Divine Aura.
Added Radiant Aegis to utility tracking.
